verdict.rationale: Google Voice is a SaaS telephony service, so versioned APIs with a deprecation policy is a fair question to ask of it. The pack shows no Voice-specific versioned API and no documented deprecation policy. The only API citation is the Workspace Admin Reports API (v1 in the URL), a host-platform reporting endpoint rather than a Voice API, and it says nothing about deprecation. The OpenAPI probes all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
